desc: The Board of Directors of the company in its meeting held today i.e., on August 31, 2026 have approved the items as mentioned in the outcome attached.
Conversion of dues by issuing 1,50,00,000 equity shares on a preferential basis at an issue price of Rs.4.74/- each (including a premium of Rs.2.74/- each).
The 32nd AGM of the company will be held on September 30, 2026 at 10.30 A.M thorough Video Conferencing (VC) / Other Auido- Visual Means to consider the businesses mentioned in the Notice

The Register of Members and Share Transfer Books of the Company will remain closed from September 24, 2026 to September 30, 2026 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of 32nd Annual General Meeting of the company to be held on September 30, 2026
